subject: Follow-up: Sentinel Health security discovery & ID/Access artifacts
messages:
From: Elaine Chambers <elaine.chambers@sentinelhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@sentinelhealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: security items / ID & access

Marissa,

Thanks for the product walkthrough this morning — helpful session. A few security and identity items came up on our side that we need to capture for procurement and our InfoSec team before we can move to a pilot: 

1) SOC 2 status: are you currently SOC 2 Type II? If not, do you have a roadmap and expected date?
2) Data residency and GDPR/HIPAA posture: high level statement of processing locations and HIPAA approach.
3) SSO/IdP support: we need confirmation you support SAML 2.0 IdP-initiated SSO and SAML metadata.
4) SCIM provisioning: docs and schema you support, whether you support group-to-role mapping and provisioning delta.
5) RBAC/admin controls: sample role matrix and privileged admin separation.
6) Any vendor security questionnaire or POI we should complete — procurement asked for a concise artifact list.

Can you send a short recap and the artifacts you can share this week? Ideally our InfoSec has the SOC summary and an SSO/SCIM checklist by end of week.

Regards,
Elaine Chambers
Director, Security Operations
Sentinel Health

[Attachment: sentinel-demo-notes.pdf (text)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chambers <elaine.chambers@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-07T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: security items / ID & access

Hi Elaine — great to meet you and the Sentinel team earlier. Thanks for pulling the list together. Recap below and what we can share immediately: 

SOC 2: Redwood currently has a SOC 2 Type II report covering our hosted control plane and production inference service for the period ending 2027-06-30. I attached a one-page summary (redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf). Full report available under NDA.

Data residency / HIPAA: We offer region-pinned deployments (US, EU) and provide a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for HIPAA-covered customers. High-level whitepaper attached and we can route you to our compliance team for any deep dives.

SSO / SAML: We support SAML 2.0 SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. SAML metadata and example IdP settings can be shared — see redwood-id-access-checklist.xlsx for fields we usually exchange.

SCIM: We implement SCIM 2.0 with support for user and group provisioning, delta sync, and attribute mapping for role assignment. API endpoints and a sample schema are in the checklist.

RBAC / admin controls: We maintain a role matrix (Admin, Organization Admin, Billing Admin, App Admin, Read-only) and support separate privileged admin accounts. The checklist includes recommended group-to-role mappings.

Next steps I propose:
- Ill drop an artifacts package (SOC2 summary, ID/Access checklist) to a shared Drive folder by EOD.
- Please confirm the procurement contact and whether Sentinel needs an executed NDA or full SOC 2 report.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min IDS deep-dive with our security engineer (Karthik) this week.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf, redwood-id-access-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf (pdf)]

Hi Elaine — following up with the artifacts pack we discussed. Links and a short summary below: 

Artifacts delivered:
- redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf (summary page attached)
- redwood-id-access-checklist.xlsx (SAML/SCIM schema + example mappings)
- role_matrix_example.csv (sample role-to-group mapping)

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QxExampleDriveLink
DocuSign (NDA / SOC2 access): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=prod&id=2Example

Quick notes on the items you asked about: 
- SAML: we provide SP and IdP metadata; we support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO. Example metadata is in the checklist.
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 with PATCH operations for delta provisioning; group-to-role mapping is supported via the customGroup attribute in the schema (see sample).
- RBAC: role separation enforced through org-level Admins and scoped App Admins. Audit logs for admin actions are retained per the chosen retention policy (default 90 days; extended options available).

If you want, I can jump on a 30-minute call to walk your engineers through the SCIM payloads and mapping patterns. Are you available tomorrow or Friday?

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: role_matrix_example.csv (spreadsheet)]
